title: decaisnina ovatifolia
intro: Decaisnina ovatifolia, commonly known as  'Sarangia', is a plant species found in the tropical forests of Asia and Australia. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of D. ovatifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of D. ovatifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
